text:
emma: Quick heads-up — release v1.5 cutoff is in ~4 hours. Code freeze goes live at 00:00 UTC. Only emergency/validated patches after that. Please don't merge non-exception PRs. :warning:

emma: Exception process: open a GitHub issue in the release repo, add label `release/late-exception`, ping @jordan + release leads, include: link to PR, a short risk paragraph, test matrix results, and a plan for rollback. CI must be green and canary signed off.

emma: If you need a cherry-pick to release branch, add the `release/cherry-pick-needed` label and include the SHA. Ops will help push once approved.

raj: quick q — PR runtime#4922 is a tiny perf bump (no API changes). Tests green locally. Is that eligible as an exception? :eyes:

emma: @raj — maybe. We need canary results on staging + a short perf regression check. If you can get @lina or @jordan to ack and add the label, we can triage.

raj: copying steps here for clarity:
```
# cherry-pick example
git checkout release/v1.5
git cherry-pick -x <commit-sha>
# run e2e
make e2e-fast
```

raj: added `release/late-exception` to runtime#4922 and requested review from @jordan.

ci-bot: The branch protection bot noticed a label change on https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4922 — running required checks: unit, integration, canary. Merge blocked until all checks pass.

lina: if this goes in, add a one-line changelog under docs/changelog/unreleased.md — template: `runtime: perf tweak — reduces latency for batching` — I'll take the short note if you paste it.

raj: pasted changelog line in the PR description and added tests for batch path. :thumbsup:

jordan: quick gate: I need a link to canary logs + a short rollback plan (what exactly we revert). If both are clear and CI + canary pass, I'll approve the exception.

raj: canary logs: https://canary.internal.redwood/reports/2026-03-17/runtime-4922 — no errors, 99.9% p99 within target. Rollback is a single revert commit to release branch, revert sha: abc1234.

jordan: good. I'm approving in GH and will add `release/approved` label once the deployment window opens.

ci-bot: All checks passed for runtime#4922. Merge allowed after release lead signoff.

emma: thanks all — remember: if you don't have `release/late-exception` and `release/approved` labels, the merge will be blocked. If you need help with the cherry-pick step ping @opsbot. :shipit:

opsbot: ops note — if we promote this to release branch after freeze, we'll schedule the push during the +15 to +45 min window post-cutoff to avoid traffic spikes. Notify #incidents if anything unexpected.

raj: done, will monitor post-merge for the +45m window. thanks. :rocket:

emma: final reminder — docs and changelog updates must be merged before the buildstamp. If anything slips, create an immediate issue and tag `release/rollback-candidate`.

lina: noted, I'll sync the changelog fragment into the release notes PR now. :memo:

jordan: closing the loop — approved and pinned to release/v1.5. Good job getting tests green.

emma: closing — thanks for the fast turn around. :tada:
